questions.title: Which UK party leader will announce plans in early July 2026 to resign as an MP and contest the resulting by-election?
questions.background: A parliamentary resignation can trigger a by-election, which the departing MP may contest to seek a fresh mandate.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public announcements corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from BBC News, The Guardian, or Al Jazeera.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the UK political party leader who publicly announces, between July 1 and July 9, 2026, plans to resign from the House of Commons and stand in the by-election caused by that resignation. The announcement is sufficient; the by-election need not have taken place.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The party leader's full name.

questions.title: If Morgan Rogers leaves Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will he join?
questions.background: Morgan Rogers is an England international and an attacking player for Aston Villa.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official announcement from either club confirming a completed permanent transfer, corroborated by reputable sports reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Conditional on Rogers completing a permanent transfer away from Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window, resolve to the acquiring club. If he completes multiple transfers during the window, use his first permanent transfer from Aston Villa.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the acquiring football club.
questions.accepted_format: The name of the acquiring football club.

questions.title: Which club will Cape Verde goalkeeper Vozinha join after Chaves in 2026?
questions.background: Vozinha is a Cape Verde international goalkeeper. Chaves is a Portuguese football club.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official club or player announcement, or reliable contemporaneous sports reporting confirming a completed move.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the first club Vozinha joins after leaving Chaves in 2026. Offers, negotiations, and proposed transfers do not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the club.

questions.title: Which club will sign Yan Diomande from RB Leipzig in summer 2026?

questions.accepted_format: The commonly used name of the destination club.
